daavy-lightswitch.settings.playerToggleD: Allow players to toggle new lights
When enabled, newly created lights can be turned on and off by players unless the GM disables the option on that light.
daavy-lightswitch.settings.debug.name: Debug mode
daavy-lightswitch.settings.debug.hint: Log detailed light switch diagnostics to the browser console and show debug notifications.
daavy-lightswitch.settings.showForGM.nam: Show light switch buttons for GMs
daavy-lightswitch.settings.showForGM.hin: When enabled, GMs also see the canvas buttons for lights that allow player switching.
daavy-lightswitch.ambientLightConfig.pla: Players can click this light on the canvas to turn it on or off.
